videos.title: Why Does Congress Skew Older Than the Public?: Crash Course US Government #8
videos.author: CrashCourse
videos.description:
Congress is more diverse than it was a hundred, fifty, or even ten years ago. But it still doesn’t reflect the diversity of the United States. In this episode , we’ll consider if Congress will ever look like the public, and if it really even matters.
